title: SEAR: Sample Efficient Action Chunking Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2603.01891v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Action chunking improves exploration and accelerates value propagation in long-horizon reinforcement learning, but naively applying off-policy methods to the temporally extended action space at reduced decision frequency offsets these gains, leading to poor sample efficiency. Existing online action chunking methods address these issues through computationally expensive critic-only approaches or by relying on offline data. We introduce SEAR, a sample-efficient off-policy algorithm that enables online reinforcement learning with action chunks by addressing both challenges. To handle high-dimensional action sequences, SEAR employs a causal transformer critic trained with multi-horizon targets that provide a training signal for every prefix of an action chunk, effectively increasing the useful gradients per sample. To restore decision frequency, SEAR operates with a receding horizon and random replanning, ensuring uniform state coverage

translated_title: SEAR：样本高效的动作分块强化学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.01891v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：动作分块在长时程强化学习中改善了探索并加速了价值传播，但天真地将离策略方法应用于降低决策频率的时间扩展动作空间会抵消这些收益，导致样本效率低下。现有的在线动作分块方法通过计算成本高昂的仅批评者方法或依赖离线数据来解决这些问题。我们引入了SEAR，一种样本高效的离策略算法，通过解决这两个挑战，实现了带有动作分块的在线强化学习。为了处理高维动作序列，SEAR采用了一个因果变换器批评者，该批评者使用多时域目标进行训练，为动作分块的每个前缀提供训练信号，有效增加了每个样本的有用梯度。为了恢复决策频率，SEAR采用后退时域和随机重规划操作，确保状态覆盖均匀。
tldr: SEAR通过多时域目标训练的因果变换器批评者和后退时域随机重规划，实现了样本高效的在线动作分块强化学习，同时解决了高维动作序列和决策频率恢复的挑战。
en_tdlr: SEAR achieves sample-efficient online action chunking reinforcement learning via a causal transformer critic with multi-horizon targets and receding-horizon random replanning, addressing both high-dimensional action sequences and decision frequency restoration.
